_doc: MakerBeamXL: a 15 x 15 mm aluminium beam with a T-slot in each face that a plain M3 nut slides into, a core hole threaded M3 at both ends, and a small hole in each corner. Dimensions are from MakerBeam B.V.'s technical drawing of the 100 mm beam (2025) and its overview of specifications (2016). Area, second moments and weight are MakerBeam B.V.'s overview of specifications. The drawn outline leaves out the rounds in the slots and the lobes of the holes (they are drawn round).
